# Senator Unpopular

As Chuck Schumer's supporters tell it, Democrats can't switch Senate majority
leaders now, not after [they won](https://zeteo.com/p/chris-van-hollen-can-
take-down-schumer) **" the World Series"** with Schumer as their **"
manager."**

It wouldn't be right to replace Schumer, per Senators [Kirsten
Gillibrand](https://transcripts.cnn.com/show/cnc/date/2026-11-10/segment/11)
and [Angus
King](https://transcripts.cnn.com/show/cnc/date/2026-11-10/segment/12), not
after he worked so hard to raise money for Democrats in the midterms - even
more money than Elon Musk, one single donor, spent boosting Republicans.

And who knows whether Chris Van Hollen, Schumer's opponent for Senate majority
leader, would be as **" comfortable"** as Schumer with this **" grubby"**
aspect of the job, fundraising, as MS NOW commentator Jonathan Capehart [put
it](https://x.com/ClippingWings/status/2121978690120618485) this weekend.
(Never mind that Van Hollen has led both the Senate and House campaign arms in
the past.)

And yet, two [new](https://www.dataforprogress.org/blog/2026/11/16/democratic-
leaning-voters-favor-van-hollen-over-schumer-for-majority-leader)
[polls](https://x.com/ShibleyTelhami/status/2122450846398939216) released
Monday suggest Democratic voters would like to see Senate Democrats replace
Schumer with Van Hollen.

A [survey](https://www.dataforprogress.org/blog/2026/11/16/democratic-leaning-
voters-favor-van-hollen-over-schumer-for-majority-leader) from Data for
Progress found 56% of Democrats and Dem-leaning independents believe that **"
Senate Democrats should choose a new leader."** A plurality said they support
Van Hollen over Schumer.

from the University of Maryland similarly found that a plurality of Democratic
voters would prefer to see Van Hollen lead the Senate instead of Schumer.
